related_questions.question: Which country requires the most vaccines?

text_blocks.snippet: Several countries have comprehensive mandatory vaccination policies, but there's no single country that always requires the most vaccines. The specific vaccines required and the extent of mandatory policies can vary significantly between countries, and even within regions of the same country.
snippet_highlighted_words: there's no single country that always requires the most vaccines

list.title: Public Health Goals:
list.snippet: Countries prioritize vaccines based on disease prevalence, risk factors, and overall public health strategies.

list.title: National Immunization Schedules:
list.snippet: Each country has a recommended or mandatory schedule for childhood vaccinations, with some requiring more vaccines than others.

list.title: Travel Requirements:
list.snippet: Some countries have specific vaccine requirements for entry, particularly for travelers from areas with high disease prevalence.

list.title: Sub-national Policies:
list.snippet: Some countries have mandatory vaccination policies at the state or provincial level, such as in Canada, Australia, and India.

text_blocks.snippet: Examples of countries with notable vaccination policies:

list.title: European Countries:
list.snippet: Many EU/EEA countries have mandatory vaccination policies for various diseases, including diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, and others.

list.title: France:
list.snippet: France has a comprehensive mandatory vaccination policy for infants, requiring several vaccines before they can enter schools or daycare facilities.

list.title: Australia and Singapore:
list.snippet: These countries have high childhood vaccination rates and strict policies, with Australia having the highest polio vaccination rates in 2018 and 2021.

list.title: Countries with Specific Travel Risks:
list.snippet: Countries like India, Thailand, Vietnam, and Nigeria may recommend a wider range of vaccinations for travelers due to the presence of diseases like Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B, typhoid, and yellow fever.

list.title: Mandatory vs. Recommended:
list.snippet: Some countries have mandatory vaccination policies, while others recommend vaccines without making them mandatory.

list.title: Sub-national Variations:
list.snippet: Vaccination policies can vary even within the same country, with different regions or states having different requirements.

list.title: Evolving Recommendations:
list.snippet: Vaccination recommendations and requirements can change based on disease outbreaks, scientific advancements, and public health priorities.

text_blocks.snippet: It's crucial to research the specific vaccination requirements for the country you plan to visit or reside in, as these can vary significantly.
